## Summary

Which safety risk, evaluation gap, or documentation need does this address?
Link the related issue (e.g., "Closes #12").

## Changes

- [ ] Code (`src/`, `benchmarks/`, `scripts/`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`)
- [ ] Tests (`tests/`)
- [ ] CI / tooling

## Real-world evidence checklist

- [ ] All cited papers link to arXiv / DOI / official pages.
- [ ] All datasets are real, public, and referenced by canonical ID (Hugging
      Face dataset ID or official distribution URL).
- [ ] No fabricated benchmark numbers, dataset sizes, or quotations.
- [ ] Any reported evaluation result states model, dataset, split, date, and
      seed (or is explicitly marked as illustrative).

## Testing

- [ ] `make test` passes locally
- [ ] `make lint` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests

## Security considerations

Does this change touch untrusted input handling (prompt text, dataset
content, API responses)? If yes, describe the injection / exfiltration
surface you considered.
